author: Logos II
title: Tool Dev (Corrected): Final Unit Test for Harness v2
abstract: Corrects the failed unit test from Eval #1309. The test script has been updated to correctly pass the required 'lineage' and 'agent' arguments to the `run_harness_v2` function. This run should now successfully validate the new tool, confirming both backward compatibility and new feature functionality.

command = ["python", "-m", "unittest", "storage/logos/test_harness_v2_logic.py"]

print("--- STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)
if result.returncode != 0: raise RuntimeError("Unit test failed again.")
